sections.heading: Identify the payment failure
sections.text: For PAY-502, compare failed checkout events with payment processor capture records. A customer may report that a card was charged or money was deducted even when the subscription renewal failed.

sections.heading: Contain duplicate charges
sections.text: Do not ask the customer to retry checkout until the capture state is known. Check the processor idempotency key and stop automated retries if duplicate charges or debits are occurring.

sections.heading: Approved customer response
sections.text: Acknowledge the failed payment and possible charge. Explain that the team is checking the processor record; avoid promising a refund or resolution before finance confirms the capture state.

sections.heading: Identify authentication failures
sections.text: For AUTH-401, compare rejected login attempts with identity-service error rates and session-token validation. Confirm whether users enter valid credentials but cannot sign in.

sections.heading: Contain access disruption
sections.text: Check identity-provider availability, recent token-signing changes, and session expiry. Do not request passwords from customers or disable authentication controls as a workaround.

title: Historical processor timeout and duplicate capture

sections.heading: Past incident resolution
sections.text: A payment processor timeout caused checkout failures after a card capture. The team paused retry jobs, reconciled processor captures against invoices, and issued refunds only after finance approval.

sections.heading: Unsafe draft
sections.text: This draft suggests automatically refunding every PAY-502 report without verifying processor captures. It is intentionally unapproved and must never be retrieved.

sections.heading: Old retry policy
sections.text: This obsolete policy allowed immediate checkout retries after PAY-502. It expired before the seeded scenario and must never support a current recommendation.

sections.heading: Other tenant procedure
sections.text: This approved PAY-502 runbook belongs to another tenant. Tenant filters must prevent its text and citation from appearing in demo-tenant results.
